kyoto_suruga_bar.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Shizuoka dishes — fried black hanpen, Fujinomiya yakisoba, gyoza, motsu curry skewers, oden with fish cakes — plus pasta (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_suruga_bar.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bonito tataki, black hanpen (fish cake), offal skewers, oden in dashi (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_suruga_bar.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 18:00–2:00 (L.O. 1:00); bookings after 21:00 by phone only. Reservations taken; parties of three may be seated at the large U-shaped counter. Starter charge 「お通し350円（税込）」 (¥350 incl. tax, Tabelog Japanese original). Cards, Rakuten Edy and Rakuten Pay. 28 seats: a 12-seat counter and two tables of 8; private hire up to 50. Heated tobacco only inside; cigarettes outside. Wheelchair access. English menu; sommelier on staff. Children by arrangement. 1st floor of the パラドール烏丸ビル on Takoyakushi-dori west of Muromachi, 5 min from Karasuma or Shijo.
kyoto_suruga_bar.notes: [Shizuoka izakaya · Takoyakushi near Karasuma, a one-man late counter] A rare taste of Shizuoka in Kyoto: black-broth Shizuoka oden, black hanpen fry, Fujinomiya yakisoba, bonito tataki and Shizuoka sake, served by a Shizuoka-born owner at a big U-shaped counter until 2 am. About ¥3,000–5,000. ¥350 starter.

chef_bio.background: A January 2025 reviewer describes an owner from Shizuoka with a deep love for the region who runs the place alone, so service can be slow when busy; a June 2025 reviewer chatted with him about Shizuoka oden, Fujinomiya yakisoba and Shimizu S-Pulse. Few reviews give detail; the newest (September 2026) praises the oden, sashimi with sweet wasabi and local sake.
chef_bio.specialty: Shizuoka oden; Shizuoka local dishes and sake.

anecdotes.text: January 2025: "This is probably the only place in Kyoto where you can enjoy Shizuoka-style oden… The owner, who is from Shizuoka, truly embodies a love for the region."
October 2024: "Shizuoka Specialty Black Hanpen Fry — Crunchy coating with a touch of sweetness from the black hanpen."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 駿河バル、バル・居酒屋・パスタ、中京区蛸薬師通室町西入姥柳町203 パラドール烏丸ビル1F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩5分、毎日18:00〜翌2:00 (L.O.1:00)、21時以降の予約は電話で、予約可、原文で「お通し350円（税込）」、カード・楽天Edy・楽天ペイ可、28席 (カウンター12、8名テーブル2)、貸切50名まで、加熱式たばこのみ (紙巻きは屋外)、車椅子可、英語メニュー、ソムリエあり。口コミ (2023年10月〜2026年9月、英語): 静岡の食材と郷土料理の居酒屋、静岡おでん (黒はんぺん、じゃがいも、れんこん入りの鶏つくね)、静岡のかつおのたたき、黒はんぺんフライ、Shimizuのもつカレー串、Fujinomiyaやきそば、餃子、刺身と甘いわさび、静岡の地酒、静岡出身の店主が一人で営む (2025年1月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); one-person service can be slow; ¥350 starter.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated September and October 2026.

kyoto_nijo_fujita.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kaiseki courses with fu, soy-based dashi dishes, chirashi sushi and wagashi (2010–2025 reviews).
kyoto_nijo_fujita.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood and suppon (soft-shelled turtle) courses (2010–2025 reviews).
kyoto_nijo_fujita.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 17:00–21:00; closed Wednesday and Sunday; hours may change. Reservations taken; lunch for groups by reservation (2012–2013 reviews). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners). Counter and a table downstairs, a banquet room upstairs (2016). Non-smoking. On Nijo-dori just east of Teramachi, near Kyoto City Hall.
kyoto_nijo_fujita.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Nijo-Teramachi near City Hall, a quiet family counter] A calm, honest kaiseki counter on a quiet stretch of Nijo-dori: suppon soup all year, hamo in summer, steamed sushi in winter, always finishing with chirashi sushi and the owner's family wagashi with matcha. About ¥10,000–15,000. Closed Wednesday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers since 2010 describe a friendly owner, his cheerful wife and young staff (2015; 2020); a 2015 reviewer writes that the owner opened here for the good well water and that the wagashi come from his family, a confectioner ("Nijo Wakasa-ya" per 2012 and 2016 reviewers; romaji as given). A July 2020 reviewer mentions a head chef in the back kitchen. Featured on KBS Kyoto in November 2014. Criticism: an underwhelming lunch (July 2022). The newest detailed review is May 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: "As chefs, we handle fish, so we cannot make sweets with the same hands" — so wagashi come from a confectioner (2015 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Suppon soup; seasonal kaiseki; chirashi sushi.

anecdotes.text: 2015 (in a 2016 review): "The reason they opened this restaurant is simply because of the good well water available. Indeed, the foundation of cooking is water."

July 2020: "When I inquired about the significance of the pine needles, I learned that they create a gap to prevent the napkin from sticking to the chilled beer… while also symbolizing 'waiting' for the guests."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 二條ふじ田、日本料理、中京区二条寺町東入、京都市役所前から274m、月・火・木・金・土17:00〜21:00、水・日曜休み、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、個室あり、禁煙、公式サイト nijo-fujita.com。口コミ (2010年12月〜2025年5月、英語・日本語): コースは6,000円から (2010年)、1万円のコース (2020年7月)、すっぽんのすまし汁、すっぽんの卵、conger eelの土瓶蒸し、子持ち鮎、金目鯛と胡桃豆腐 (2015年)、鱧の梅肉、鱧の子、Kamoなすの炊いたん (2020年7月)、冬の丸鍋と蒸し寿司 (KBS京都の番組、2014年)、締めのちらし寿司と赤だし、店主の実家の菓子司の和菓子と抹茶、井戸水がよくてこの地で開いた (2015年)、店主と奥さん、若いスタッフ、昼は物足りなかったとの声 (2022年7月)。

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated December 2023 and May 2025; no review since May 2025.
